title: Auth-recipe cache eviction policy + schema migration path (closes #327 silent-fail gap)
goal: #327 made store_recipe REJECT new entries when the 50 KB dir cap engages — no eviction, no LRU, just permanent rejection. Once the cache is full, NEW fingerprints get an absent verdict forever and pay the Claude Haiku call on EVERY run. Same problem: schema_version mismatch returns absent (forward-compat), but there is no migration path — older recipes are simply ignored forever (re-paying the AI call) until manually deleted. This task adds (a) an LRU eviction policy when the dir cap engages, keyed on `last_confirmed_at`, and (b) a schema-migration hook that upgrades v1→v2 recipes in place on first read (or marks them for re-derivation in a bounded way) instead of silently discarding them.
scope: Extend `api/app/services/auth_discoverer.py` store_recipe(): when dir-cap is breached, instead of returning False, evict the N oldest entries (by last_confirmed_at, falling back to created_at) until the new entry fits, then proceed. Cap eviction at 25% of entries per call to prevent thrashing. Also add `_migrate_recipe(recipe_dict, *, target_schema_version)` that handles known version-up patterns (v1→v2 field renames if any exist by then); for unknown source versions, return None and log a single warning per fingerprint per process (not per call). Update lookup_recipe to call _migrate_recipe before returning fresh.
generation_reason: Identified during the 10-task deferred-capability audit. #327 task body said 'store rejects when dir cap engages (loop writes ~140 entries until dir reaches 50 KB, then a fresh hash also fails)' as a SUCCESS criterion — but in production, the cache filling up means we re-pay $$$ AI calls forever on new fingerprints. That's a regression dressed as a feature. Same for schema_version: 'forward-compat path returns absent' means every old recipe becomes dead weight on schema bump. No follow-up was filed. Operator pushback 2026-05-17 spirit: 'constraints moet je zelf oplossen, niet doorlopen'.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Eviction + migration only. Do NOT change the 2 KB per-file cap (#327 contract), do NOT change the 50 KB dir cap (#327 contract), do NOT alter the verdict vocabulary (fresh/stale/absent — #327 contract), do NOT touch the build_recipe AI path (#326 contract).
constraints.bounded_eviction: Eviction caps at 25% of entries per store call to prevent thrashing under churn.
constraints.non_destructive_on_uncertainty: If two entries have the SAME last_confirmed_at, evict the one with the lower confidence score; ties beyond that → evict neither (force the store call to return False rather than make an arbitrary choice).
constraints.schema_migration_idempotent: Calling _migrate_recipe on an already-migrated recipe is a no-op (returns input unchanged).

success_criteria: store_recipe with full cache evicts oldest entries (by last_confirmed_at) and accepts the new entry, instead of returning False.
Eviction is bounded to 25% of entries per call.
Schema-mismatched recipes from a known older version are migrated in place and returned as fresh.
Schema-mismatched recipes from an unknown version still return absent + log a single warning per fingerprint per process (not per call).

Unit tests: cache eviction frees space; eviction order is correct (oldest first); tie-breaking on confidence; ties beyond that → store returns False; migration round-trip; unknown version returns absent + warning fired exactly once.
No regression in the 29 existing test_auth_discoverer_cache.py tests.
must_not_touch: 5 migrated probes (consume cache through lookup_recipe — interface unchanged)

acceptance_criteria: Full cache + new store call → eviction + accept, not silent rejection.
Schema migration upgrades v1→vN in place; unknown version → absent + single warning.
All existing cache tests pass; new eviction + migration tests added.
